title: Approximate Message Passing with Random Initialization for Phase Retrieval
summary: We analyze approximate message passing (AMP) with an independent Gaussian initialization for noiseless phase retrieval in the proportional asymptotic regime. A random initialization has overlap of order $d^{-1/2}$ with the signal, and AMP requires a growing number of iterations to attain non-vanishing overlap. Thus, its precise behavior cannot be characterized by classical fixed-time state evolution.
